label: A thought that is true or false…, from Every act of thought that is true or false… and 1 more
meaning: Metaphysics IV.7, 1012a2-5, reading A: a thought that is true or false settles its object. Four-case derivation, constructive. It excludes a third act of thought that is true or false (the intermediate). The intuitionist accepts it: the withholder makes no true-or-false judgment about an undecided proposition, so the result says nothing about it.
